title: The Veil of Caerlum
author: Mirabel Vane
blurb: Freya Whitlock, a bone-carver who hears the dead, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
